note: One entry per Space Cat voice line: the ElevenLabs request of each take (2 takes per line, 2026-11-17; a third take for demo). The voice is Book 2's narrator. The spoken text can differ from the caption (pronunciation fixes: שִׂיא from "שִׂי", the kamatz katan of כָּל from "כֹּל"). `chosen` is filled in when the parent has picked a take; only a chosen take is copied to `file`. new-best plays Book 2's take new-best-1 (see asset-sources/duel2/audio.json). The four ladder lines (compare, jumps, times, divide) were made and picked on 2026-11-20 (take 2 of each).
